authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant AI generation artifacts despite high semantic alignment. The most prominent defect is the 'transparency' or 'melting' effect on the chair backs; the woven mesh texture fails to occlude the background correctly, allowing flowers and walls to show through the solid parts of the chair structure in a physically impossible way. Additionally, the leg geometry shows structural inconsistencies, particularly where legs meet the ground (slight fusion) and in the complex joint areas under the seats. The texture itself has a repetitive, noisy quality typical of generative models struggling with fine mesh patterns. While the overall composition is recognizable, these physical impossibilities prevent a high authenticity score.
key_defects: Transparency/Melting artifacts on chair backs (background visible through solid mesh)
Structural inconsistency in leg joints and ground contact points
Repetitive/noisy texture pattern on woven surfaces
